verses.1: Do not be frightened in your heart. Do not rush to say something before God. For God is in heaven, and you are on earth. Therefore, your words will be weak.
verses.2: For the dream came with great difficulties, and its voice was like that of a fool who said many foolish things.
verses.3: When you seek to please God, do not focus on your own desires. For the foolish do not have any desire to please Him at all.
verses.4: It is good that you do not stay in one place for too long, and do not be burdened by it.
verses.5: Do not give in to temptation and do not speak before the priest that it is a mistake. Why should God be angry at your words and disapprove of your actions?
verses.6: For in many dreams and illusions, and with many things, one still fears God.
verses.7: If a person is unjust and deceitful, and acts in accordance with injustice and wickedness, then you will see that in that country: do not be deceived by it. For its heights are higher than those of the mountains and hills.
verses.8: And the land will be filled with all kinds of crops; it will be a land used for farming.
verses.9: He loves money, but it cannot be satisfied by money. And he doesn’t love those who are like him at all. Even then, the darkness still remains.
verses.10: In abundance of good things, her enjoyment increases; and what is most pleasing to her husband is, indeed, what his eyes see.
verses.11: Whether the servant has worked hard or not, and whether he has eaten enough or not, if he has spent all his money, then it’s not right for him to be allowed to rest.
verses.12: I saw a disease under the sun. For a hundred nights, it afflicted its owner with illness.
verses.13: And that hundred was lost in a bad situation. He had a son, but he didn’t have anything to give him.
verses.14: As he left his mother’s house, the evil spirit returned to him. He was afraid that he wouldn’t be able to carry the burden on his own shoulders.
verses.15: And also, this is a bad disease. It will spread throughout everything that comes into contact with it. What can be done to stop its spread?
verses.16: And all his days he would eat in darkness; he would also get very angry, and he would suffer from illness and pain.
verses.17: Now, since I have seen that he is good, and that he is beautiful in all his actions and looks. He works under the sun for the days of his life, which God has given him as part of his destiny.
verses.18: And all those people who were given wealth and possessions by God, and who were allowed to eat from it, to take their share, and to rejoice in their labor… these people also died as a punishment from God.
verses.19: For he doesn’t remember his own days very much, because God delights in him.
